title: The New Mandate: first gameplay trailer for my AI-assisted RTS, built with Bevy (pre-alpha)
author: DVSoftware
selftext:
I'm building The New Mandate, a real-time strategy game and spiritual successor to Command & Conquer, in Rust with Bevy. This is the first gameplay trailer, showing the Cinderline Foundry faction. It's pre-alpha, and all the footage is captured in-game.



How AI is used:

\- Code: Claude Code and Codex

\- 3D models: Tripo + Custom Blender workflow

\- Textures, build icons and particle sprites: image generation, with textures mostly painted as edits of plain clay renders

\- Unit voices: Fish Audio

\- Sound effects: Stable Audio 3 Small

\- Music: Google Lyria 3.5

Trailer: [https://youtu.be/Gk6u-AFJhXk](https://youtu.be/Gk6u-AFJhXk)

Happy to answer questions about the workflow.
